name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.85.0 — `init-gen.js ignore-check --root <dir> [--fix]` audits the pipeline's own .gitignore entries after the fact (exit 3 names each missing line; --fix appends), and /spec:doctor runs it beside the gitattributes check — a host initialised before an entry shipped (observed: `.claude/spec-session.json` on a pre-20260901/02 host) surfaced its session stamp as a spurious out-of-plan reconcile finding; the exclusion list was the wrong fix, the stamp must stay ignored, never committed; 7.84.0 — the served notes layer (`lib/notes-layer.browser.js`) now mounts its bar and panel behind shadow roots and links `viewer.css` inside them (its `--v-*` register is declared on `:host,:root`), so no chrome rule reaches a served mock's cascade; a document-level link once repainted every served mock's body in the light palette whatever its theme (`body{background;color}` and `*{box-sizing}` are chrome-page rules). New executed pin: a served dark mock computes identical body/box styles with and without the layer, read over the DevTools Protocol in headless Chrome (skips with the reason when no Chrome binary is found; the static pin never skips). 7.83.0 — a design review hub, one per machine (`design-hub.js`, `spec-paths design-hub`; state under `~/.claude/design-hub/`, port 4600 by default, `base` configured once with `config --base`), mounts every registered project under `/p/<name>/` through the same request handler `design-atlas.js serve` uses, its front page an inbox of open look stops newest first across projects; every mock look stop — the mocks driver's five looks (`shapes`, `journey:<j>`, `theme`, `review:<j>`, `signoff`), `/spec:sketch` ratification, `/spec:atlas` — now opens a stop on the hub with `stop open` and prints exactly the verified link plus the fixed reply line, then ends the turn; the driver's marks (`shape-picked`, `journey-approved`, `theme-picked`, `journey-reviewed`, `approved`) refuse without a decided stop for their key (from the page or `stop decide --by chat`) and derive the ledger's `rejected` cell from the picked group; the look-stop rule now names two shapes — catalog stops (Storybook) unchanged, mock stops the hub link.
